name: Strike
check_bonus: (if use.martial > 0 then self.martial_prof else self.simple_prof) - min(2, self.rolled.melee_strike + self.rolled.finesse_strike + self.rolled.ranged_strike + self.rolled.spell_attack + self.rolled.creature_strike + (if self.condition.swung then 1 else 0)) * use.map

values.amount: use.damage + 0 + (if self.sneak_dice > 0 and (target.off_guard or combat.distance <= 1 and combat.allies_near > 0) then roll(self.sneak_dice, 6) else 0)
(use.damage + 0 + (if self.sneak_dice > 0 and (target.off_guard or combat.distance <= 1 and combat.allies_near > 0) then roll(self.sneak_dice, 6) else 0)) * 2 + use.deadly

score: 10 - 4 * min(2, self.rolled.melee_strike + self.rolled.finesse_strike + self.rolled.ranged_strike + self.rolled.spell_attack + self.rolled.creature_strike + (if self.condition.swung then 1 else 0))
